description: Screen a name (person, company, vessel, aircraft) against all loaded sanctions watchlists at once — OFAC SDN + Consolidated, EU, UK, and UN — alias- and fuzzy-aware. Returns scored potential matches with the source list, sanctioning program, designation date, and the matched alias. Strict mode (default) matches exact-normalized then all-tokens-present; fuzzy mode (or auto when strict is empty) adds Jaro-Winkler and phonetic matching and labels hits approximate with a raw 0–1 similarity score plus the count of query tokens the candidate covers, which orders candidates that tie on score. Results are paged: totalAvailable and hasMore report matches beyond the returned page, and nextOffset retrieves them. This is a screening AID for a human/compliance review, NOT a compliance determination: a hit means "review this candidate against the official source," and an empty result never means "cleared."

entityType.description: Restrict to one entity class, or "any" (default) to screen across all.

limit.description: Maximum number of potential matches to return in one page.

matchMode.description: strict (default): exact-normalized then all-tokens-present. fuzzy: also scored Jaro-Winkler + phonetic. Strict auto-falls-back to fuzzy when it finds nothing.

minScore.description: Score floor for fuzzy hits (0–1), applied uniformly to every fuzzy candidate regardless of how it was matched (Jaro-Winkler, token, or phonetic). No hit below this score is returned. Applies to fuzzy mode only; defaults to the server's configured floor.

name.description: The name to screen (person, organization, vessel, or aircraft), in any script. It must contain at least one letter or digit, and at most 64 words and 1024 characters.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first potential match to return. Re-call with the returned nextOffset to page through every match when hasMore is true; an offset past the end returns an empty page, not an error.

sources.description: Restrict to specific source lists. Omit to screen all loaded lists.

name: sanctions_screen_name

caveat.description: Decision-support caveat — this is a screening aid, not a compliance determination.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `name_not_searchable`: The name contains no letter or digit, so nothing in it can be matched. `name_too_long`: The name is longer than 64 words or 1024 characters. `mirror_not_ready`: The sanctions mirror has never completed an initial sync. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when potential matches remain beyond this page — re-call with nextOffset.

hits.description: Potential matches, ranked by match type, then score, then how much of the query each candidate explains.

items.description: One potential match — a candidate to verify, never a determination.

designationDate.description: The source's own designation date as YYYY-MM-DD; absent when unpublished.

entityType.description: Entity classification as published by the source.

matchType.description: exact = normalized name equality; strong = all query tokens present; approximate = fuzzy/phonetic.

matchedName.description: The specific name or alias string that matched the query.

matchedNameType.description: Provenance of the matched name: primary, a.k.a., f.k.a., or a low-quality a.k.a.

primaryName.description: Primary published name of the designated entity.

program.description: Sanctioning program / regime, when published by the source.

queryTokenCoverage.description: How much of the query this candidate explains, as a literal token count — a second real measurement, never folded into score. It is the tie-break applied after score, because one shared exact token pins several candidates at the same score. Absent for exact/strong hits.

covered.description: Query tokens individually matched by one of this candidate's tokens at the applied score floor.

total.description: Total tokens in the normalized query.

referenceNumber.description: The list's published reference number (UN, EU, UK OFSI Group ID); absent when the list publishes none for the entry.

score.description: Raw Jaro-Winkler similarity (0–1) for approximate hits only — a real measurement, not a confidence verdict. Absent for exact/strong hits.

source.description: Which watchlist this candidate is on — its provenance.

sourceEntryId.description: The list's own entry ID — pass to sanctions_get_designation for the full record.

sourceLabel.description: Human-readable name of the source list.

matchModeUsed.description: The match mode actually applied (strict may auto-upgrade to fuzzy on empty).

nextOffset.description: The offset to request next. Present only when hasMore is true.

normalizedQuery.description: The name as the server folded it for matching.

notice.description: Guidance when no candidate matched — how to broaden, and what an empty result does NOT mean — or when the requested offset sits past the end of the result set.

totalAvailable.description: Potential matches available across all pages, before limit and offset were applied.

totalAvailableBasis.description: How to read totalAvailable: exact = the complete strict match set; lower_bound = a bounded scan produced it (every fuzzy pass, and any strict pass that hit the raw-row scan cap), so more may exist.

totalCount.description: Number of potential matches returned in this page.

title: sanctions-screening-mcp-server: screen name
